answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: an agent must lock a deposit before it can earn, and peers attest its work, so fake identities multiply cost instead of reward. A fable of effortless abundance is what sybils sell, but at the zenith of a healthy network the ledger only rewards identities whose history proves real work, and each attestation leaves a plume of verifiable evidence that a copy cannot fake without paying the same price again.
